mechanism: Indomethacin reduces renal blood flow and tubular secretion, potentially decreasing piperacillin clearance and increasing beta-lactam levels; NSAIDs may also increase risk of acute kidney injury when combined with nephrotoxic agents.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative NSAID or timing adjustments; dose adjustments of piperacillin may be necessary if renal impairment develops.
